selector.rationale: The presence of well-circumscribed, violaceous, annular patches and the lack of mucous membrane involvement or other systemic symptoms support Granuloma annulare as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Dermatitis Herpetiformis
rejected.why: The absence of blisters and the specific morphology of the lesions do not strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Mycosis Fungoides
rejected.why: While lymphocytes obscuring the dermal-epidermal junction could suggest Mycosis Fungoides, the clinical presentation and lack of other supportive findings make it less likely.

rejected.label: contact dermatitis
rejected.why: The lack of response to discontinuation of underarm deodorant and the specific characteristics of the lesions make contact dermatitis a less likely diagnosis.

contradict_spans: denied any recent trauma or history of similar lesions
